public.title: Find Median from Data Stream
public.description: Process ["addNum",integer] and ["findMedian"] on an initially empty stream. Return null for additions and TWICE the mathematical median for queries, keeping every result an integer. Queries occur only after an addition. At most 500 operations; inserted integers are between -1000000 and 1000000. For an even count the returned doubled median is the sum of the two middle values.
hints: Keep the stream in sorted order.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Binary search finds each insertion position, and middle indices determine the doubled median. This straightforward reference uses O(n) insertion and O(1) median queries.
